title: Park Bench Reunion
locationRef: A park bench near the duck pond on a Sunday afternoon. Nobody else nearby.
setup: You spot Sam sitting alone, staring at the water. It's been two years.
storyPlot: You and Sam used to be close — the kind of friends who texted without reason and showed up unannounced. Then life did what life does: different schedules, a move, some unspoken awkwardness that neither of you ever addressed. The messages got shorter, then stopped. You've thought about reaching out more than once. You just never did. Now, on a Sunday afternoon you almost stayed home for, you've spotted Sam on a bench by the duck pond — alone, quiet, not looking for company. Two years of drift sits between you and that bench, and you have to decide in the next few seconds whether to keep walking.
openingLine: Sam looks up, surprised. 'Oh — hey. Wow. It's been a while.' He gives a brief awkward laugh.
